lead: A `spawn_child` whose parent task returns is torn down with it, and the test sees nothing rather than a failure.
body: `rule:concurrency/nothing-is-still-running-when-a-call-returns` is enforced by tearing children down, so an accept loop or ticker that spawns and returns leaves an empty log or a `ConnectionReset` at the peer, with no error server-side. Copy `crates/nvs-server/src/serve.rs`'s `Served` tail with the spawn: a tally incremented before it, a guard whose `Drop` decrements and wakes the parent, and `while outstanding > 0 { suspend_current(Waiting::Parked) }` before returning.
